question: Why did the anchor_wire group not finish in the v0.7.22 audit environment (evidence/v0.7.22/test_evidence.json: 'NOT VERIFIED: legacy multi-process anchor_wire suite TIMEOUT')?
environment: Linux x86_64, 4 CPUs, Python 3.13.17, cryptography 46.0.4, SQLite 3.45.1, euid 0 unless stated

hypotheses.claim: A long TMPDIR exceeds the AF_UNIX sun_path limit (108 bytes incl. NUL) and the daemon never comes up

measurements.setup: test_anchor_wire test_writer_service_v0714 test_anchor_v079 test_external_epoch_witness_v0719 test_external_commit_witness_v0720, TMPDIR length 60/70/71/72/73

measurements.result: FAILED (failures=1): test_anchor_v079...test_separate_uid_can_connect_but_cannot_read_anchor, OSError: AF_UNIX path too long
failures=1 / failures=1, errors=24 / failures=30, errors=50 / failures=30, errors=50

hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED as a hang cause: it fails fast, it does not hang. KEPT as an environment limit: TMPDIR must be at most 73 characters (now a preflight check in tools/run_test_groups.py).

hypotheses.claim: Daemon or helper processes survive a test and keep resources or pipes busy

measurements.setup: pgrep -af anchor_wire.py after a full anchor_wire run
tools/run_test_groups.py /proc scan of each process group after the leader exited, all 12 groups, root and non-root

hypotheses.claim: CPU starvation makes the multi-process tests miss their timing

measurements.setup: taskset -c 0 with 3 busy loops on the same core

hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED as a hang cause: slower, still passes

hypotheses.claim: A wall-clock limit of the audit sandbox ended the run

measurements.result: anchor group (91 tests incl. anchor_wire) 37.4 s; equal group 14.3 s there vs 3.1-3.4 s here, i.e. that environment was about 4-5x slower
records only 'TIMEOUT', no limit, no traceback

hypotheses.verdict: NOT REFUTED, NOT PROVEN: the most consistent explanation, but the audit environment's limit is not documented

related_runner_defect_found_and_fixed: tools/run_test_groups.py first read output through a pipe; a helper that leaves the process group and inherits stdout kept the pipe open, so a PASSING group blocked until the helper exited and was reported as a timeout (bpo-26534 class). Negative-first test test_detached_helper_does_not_block_a_passing_group failed on that version and passes after the switch to a temporary file plus waitid(WNOWAIT).
